description: An ultrafilter is principal exactly when it equals the point ultrafilter at some point.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiltersAndUltrafilters.principal_ultrafilter_iff.{u} {α : Type u} (U : Ultrafilter α) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiltersAndUltrafilters.IsPrincipal ↑U ↔ ∃ x, U = pure x
